label: Cream liqueur
note: The alcohol (about 17 % vol in Baileys) preserves the cream; the emulsion is held by homogenising with an emulsifier.

about.text: A liqueur made from dairy cream and a flavoured spirit: whiskey in Irish cream, marula-fruit spirit in Amarula, rum in several others. It can be drunk neat, on ice or in cocktails.
